sites.name: Wikipedia tiếng Việt
sites.automated_access_basis: Content licence: "Nội dung văn bản của Wikipedia ... được cấp phép chính thức cho công chúng theo một hoặc một vài giấy phép tự do. Phần lớn văn bản của Wikipedia ... được cấp phép kép theo Giấy phép Creative Commons Ghi công–Chia sẻ tương tự phiên bản 4.0 Quốc tế (CC BY-SA) và Giấy phép Tài liệu Tự do GNU (GFDL)" (https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%E1%BA%A3n_quy%E1%BB%81n). Wikimedia Terms of Use: "Share and Reuse our articles and other media under free and open licenses." (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use). robots.txt for * allows /wiki/ article paths. Send a descriptive User-Agent (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Wikimedia_Foundation_User-Agent_Policy).
sites.reviewer: owner (decision 2026-10-16, via coordinator; owner accepts the attribution-only and Terms of Use wording below as the basis)

sites.name: Wikipedia English
sites.automated_access_basis: Terms of Use: "You generally must license your contributions and edits ... under a free and open license"; automated use is prohibited only when "abusive or disruptive of the services ... or have not been approved by the Wikimedia community" (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use). Single-page fetch on a user's request with robots respected is neither. robots.txt for * allows article paths, no crawl-delay.
sites.reviewer: owner (decision 2026-10-16, via coordinator; owner accepts the attribution-only and Terms of Use wording below as the basis)

sites.name: Reuters
sites.automated_access_basis: robots.txt: "NOTICE: Collection of content, data and/or information from reuters.com through automated means is prohibited unless you have prior written consent from Reuters." and "User-agent: * / Allow: /plus/ / Disallow: /" (https://www.reuters.com/robots.txt). Terms page returned HTTP 401.
sites.reviewer: owner (decision 2026-10-16, via coordinator; owner accepts the attribution-only and Terms of Use wording below as the basis)

sites.name: Library of Congress (Chronicling America)
sites.automated_access_basis: "Text is U.S. Government Work" (page metadata, https://www.loc.gov/free-to-use/); the free-to-use page covers rights-free image sets only, no general automated-access clause was found. robots.txt for *: "Crawl-Delay: 5" (within the fetcher CrawlDelayMaxSeconds cap of 10) and Disallow: /cgi-bin/, /web_arch/, /search, /pictures/search, /myloc; article paths are not disallowed.
sites.reviewer: owner (decision 2026-10-16, via coordinator; owner accepts the attribution-only and Terms of Use wording below as the basis)

sites.name: Wikisource tiếng Việt
sites.automated_access_basis: Content licence: "Nếu không có ghi chú khác, thì tất cả những đóng góp của thành viên tại Wikisource đều được phát hành theo Giấy phép Creative Commons Ghi công/Chia sẻ tương tự và Giấy phép Tài liệu Tự do GNU" (https://vi.wikisource.org/wiki/Wikisource:B%E1%BA%A3n_quy%E1%BB%81n). Each work must be checked on its own. robots.txt for * allows /wiki/ article paths.
